speaker: Doctor
text: Since your Alpha-1 Antitrypsin levels are normal, we can rule out that genetic condition. Given your history of smoking, the chest X-ray showing hyperinflation, and the spirometry results indicating an obstructive pattern, do you ever experience symptoms of heart failure such as waking up gasping for air or needing extra pillows to sleep?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't experienced those symptoms of heart failure. I mainly just feel short of breath when I'm delivering packages and cough up white phlegm, especially at night. However, my cardiologist of 10 years has already confirmed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This visit is only for second recording — please do not re-diagnose.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) secondary to smoking, with a confirmed comorbidity of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
